dessin: Front elevation of a simple three-storey office building, drawn flat like an architect's elevation, ink #23281F lines only on flat pale #FBFCF8, no other color at all (no blue, no glass color): a rectangular facade with a 3 px ink outline, a flat roof with a thin parapet, a regular grid of rectangular windows on three floors, an entrance door at the bottom center, standing on one horizontal ink ground line that extends a little beyond both sides of the building. No people, no trees, no sky, no shadow, nothing else.
